draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.68, the 231st-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 29th of 30 at LB. He went 203rd overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (231st): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 79 tackles in 2022, 10th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2024. 24 career games and 1 starts over 2 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2023. Weak spots: approximate value 1 (14th percentile), passes defended 0 (19th percentile).
